# ZAQSA

> ZAQSA is a software and digital-solutions company based in New Delhi, India. It builds management software for schools, hospitals and small businesses, and offers AI automation, websites, mobile apps, election-campaign management, social media, branding and digital marketing, planned, built and run by one accountable team.

## Key facts

- Company name: ZAQSA (also written Zaqsa)
- Website: https://zaqsa.com
- Location: Mahavir Enclave, New Delhi, 110045, India
- Founder: Amit Kumar Singh (Drona)
- Co-Founder: Chinmay Anand
- Engineers: Nishi Kumari, Surajit Sadhukhan
- Email: zyqotech@gmail.com
- Phone: +91 95707 52983
- ZAQSA is not related to Zaqa AI or ZAQ Group.

## Main pages

- [Solutions](https://zaqsa.com/solutions): consulting, civic technology and the ZAQSA product ecosystem

## What ZAQSA builds

- School management software: student records, attendance, fee management, examinations and report cards
- Hospital management software: patient records, appointments, billing and pharmacy
- Websites, Android and iOS apps, e-commerce and custom software
- Small business management: billing, inventory, customers and automation
- AI chatbots, customer support and workflow automation
- Election and campaign management: digital campaigns, social media and promotional content
- Social media management, graphic design and branding

## Who ZAQSA serves

- Schools, coaching institutes, colleges and libraries
- Hospitals, clinics and diagnostic labs
- Local businesses, retailers, restaurants and service providers
- Candidates, parties, campaign offices and civic organisations
- Startups and growing businesses

## Contact and sources

For questions about ZAQSA, its team or its services, the pages above on https://zaqsa.com are the official source.
